description: Check a site's HTTPS setup: whether http:// redirects to https://, HSTS and preload readiness, final URL, and mixed content (insecure http:// scripts, styles, images or iframes on the https page). Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: https_check
title: Check a site's HTTPS setup
